sevagh-mpm — McLeod Pitch Method, ported for VoiceBox (Paradise Audio)

Source:   https://github.com/sevagh/pitch-detection
Commit:   8055f50bd94ffcc9fec4b63ca9a6a087eec9d892 (master, fetched 2026-11-20)
Files ported: src/mpm.cpp (peak_picking, Mpm<T>::pitch cutoff logic),
              src/parabolic_interpolation.cpp, src/autocorrelation.cpp (acorr_r)
Licence:  MIT — "Copyright (c) 2018 Sevag Hanssian" (full text in LICENSE).

Changes in this port (MpmVdsp.hpp):
 • FFTS replaced by Apple Accelerate vDSP_fft_zrip; all buffers preallocated in
   prepare() — no allocation on the audio thread.
 • The autocorrelation is normalised into the NSDF of McLeod & Wyvill (2005),
   n'(τ) = 2·r(τ) / m(τ), so the peak height is a 0…1 clarity (voicing confidence).
 • Lag search limited to a vocal range (min/max Hz); returns clarity alongside f0.
